module: Flowgraph node 'Sigmoid Smoother' (simple category). Sigmoid smoothing with newTemporalSigmoidSmoothing: speed limits upRateLimit/downRateLimit and start/stop accelerations (up/down StartAccel and StopAccel) depending on direction; 'set' forces the state. Output 'value'.
notes: BUG: the pin is declared 'downstopAccel' (lowercase s) but work reads self.pinIn.downStopAccel (nil): indexing .value on nil raises an error as soon as the input value is below the state (downward direction).
init writes C.smoother (class): the smoother is shared between all instances of the node.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Sets C.oldSet=0 and C.smoother (at class level).

checkSetValue.desc: If 'set' changed, forces the smoother state.

work.desc: With no input, outputs the state; otherwise chooses limit/start/stop depending on direction (default 1) and outputs smoother:getWithRateAccel(sample, dt, limit, start, stop).
